app.name: Todo Example
app.description: A personal to-do app with named lists of items that can be added, completed, deleted and shared.
app.instructions:
This app manages personal to-do lists: listing lists, adding items, listing items, completing items, deleting items and sharing a list by email.
Operational patterns:
- Use the list lists action to turn a list name such as "groceries" into its listId before acting on a list.
- Use the list items action to find an itemId before completing or deleting an item.
Constraints:
- Item titles are at most 200 characters.

TodoList.title: To-do List
TodoList.description: A named list that groups to-do items, such as Groceries or Work.

id.title: ID
id.description: The unique ID of the list, for example "groceries".

name.title: Name
name.description: The name the user gave the list.

openCount.title: Open Items
openCount.description: How many items on the list are not done yet.

TodoItem.title: To-do Item
TodoItem.description: One task on a to-do list.

id.title: ID
id.description: The unique ID of the item.

listId.title: List ID
listId.description: The ID of the list that holds the item.

title.title: Title
title.description: What needs to be done, for example "Buy milk".

done.title: Done
done.description: Whether the item has been completed.

dueDate.title: Due Date
dueDate.description: The day the item is due, if any.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Private notes the app keeps for its own use.

actions.name: list_lists
actions.title: List To-do Lists
actions.description: Lists the user's to-do lists with their IDs, names and number of open items.

examples.utterance: What to-do lists do I have?

actions.name: add_item
actions.title: Add Item
actions.description: Adds a new item to a to-do list and returns the created item.

listId.title: List
listId.description: The ID of the list to add the item to, for example "groceries".

title.title: Title
title.description: What needs to be done, for example "Buy milk".

dueDate.title: Due Date
dueDate.description: The day the item is due, as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit when the user gives no date.

examples.utterance: Add milk to my groceries list
Put "file taxes" on my work list for 2027-04-15

actions.name: list_items
actions.title: List Items
actions.description: Lists the items on a to-do list, optionally filtered to open or done items.

listId.title: List
listId.description: The ID of the list to read, for example "groceries".

status.title: Status
status.description: Which items to return: open, done or all. Defaults to open.

actions.name: complete_item
actions.title: Complete Item
actions.description: Marks a to-do item as done and returns the updated item.

itemId.title: Item
itemId.description: The ID of the item to mark as done.

actions.name: delete_item
actions.title: Delete Item
actions.description: Deletes a to-do item permanently. The item cannot be restored.

itemId.title: Item
itemId.description: The ID of the item to delete.

examples.utterance: Remove buy milk from my list for good

actions.name: share_list
actions.title: Share List
actions.description: Shares a to-do list with another person by email and returns the share link.

listId.title: List
listId.description: The ID of the list to share, for example "groceries".

email.title: Email
email.description: The email address of the person to share the list with.

outputSchema.title: Share Result
outputSchema.description: The outcome of sharing a list.

shareUrl.title: Share Link
shareUrl.description: The link the other person can open.

sharedWith.title: Shared With
sharedWith.description: The email address the list was shared with.

examples.utterance: Share my groceries list with sam@example.com
Send the work list to alex@example.org

skills.name: tidy-list
skills.description: Reviews one to-do list and helps the user clear out finished or stale items.
skills.instructions:
Use this when the user wants to clean up or review a list.
1. Resolve the list name to its ID with the list lists tool.
2. Read the done items with the list items tool (status done), then the open items.
3. Summarise what is finished and what is still open.
4. Offer to delete finished items one at a time. Deleting cannot be undone, so name each item before you delete it.
